block.title: Explainer posters and videos say filnix.org
block.p: GitHub Pages stopped publishing on 10 November, but the explainers' posters, their og:image tags, three Manim videos and a dozen documents still pointed at mbrock.github.io/filnix. The videos were rendered again from their video/render.sh; the five hand-made posters had only their footer line redrawn in Public Sans, size matched to the old text.
